_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored — the API key never gets committed.
_pollMs: How often to ask Google for new picks. 1500ms keeps us inside the 1-3 second target with room to spare.
_season: Which season the APP DISPLAYS — it reads players.<season>.json and friends. Separate from what `npm run refresh` pulls, which is always the current year. Switching seasons means this key plus a branches/inventory file for that year.
_ffb: thefantasyfootballers.com login, used only by `npm run refresh` to pull your UDK rankings. Never leaves this machine.

ffb._scoringSystem: Which UDK ranking set to pull. One of: STD (4pt QB), STD (6pt QB), HALF (4pt QB), HALF (6pt QB), PPR (4pt QB), PPR (6pt QB). James's league is half-PPR with 6-point passing TDs.

_source: 'sheet' reads the live Google Sheet. 'local' reads data/board.local.json instead, so the app runs with no API key — useful for testing before draft day.
